title: Script memory data
description: The single input that build_memory_html.py injects into template.html. Produced by the agent after reading the extracted script text. Dialogue text (k=L) must be byte-identical to the source script.

title.description: Work title as shown in the page header, e.g. "Brave to Speak".

subtitle.description: Optional Chinese / secondary title, e.g. "勇敢开麦".

blurb.description: Optional one-line summary under the header. Omit to let the page generate one from roles, beats and line count.

roles.description: Speaker labels exactly as they appear in the script, plus the ensemble label if any lines are spoken together, e.g. ["A","B","A & B"]. Omit to derive from the script.

ensemble.description: The label used for lines spoken together. Leave empty for monologues. Omit to derive (first role containing '&').

myRoles.description: Roles to pre-select as the learner's own. Omit to default to the first single-speaker role, or to all roles when only one exists.

beatUnit.description: Counter used for the skeleton cards: "拍" for stage beats, "段" for paragraphs of a speech.

anchorWords.description: How many leading words of a line are revealed as the recall anchor.

cheatWords.description: How many leading words of a line are written into the cue sheet.

stateKey.description: localStorage key for progress. Omit for an auto-generated one derived from the title.

labels.description: Display names for the inline cue codes.

keyParts.description: Repeated sentence patterns worth drilling as reusable parts, e.g. "and you? ×2". Shown in the help card and the copied instructions.

rescueLines.description: Three or so improvised lines the performer can fall back on if dry, e.g. the partner can be cued instead.

cadence.description: Optional replacement for the default four-day rehearsal cadence line.

beatHint.description: Optional replacement for the hint text under the skeleton cards.

help.description: Optional overrides for the in-page help card. Provide only what should differ from the defaults.

lead.description: Rows at the top of the help card. A null second element marks where the memory-method block is injected.

beats.description: Skeleton cards: the few images the whole piece collapses into. Omit to derive from the k=B headings.

name.description: Short counter label, e.g. "拍 1" or "段 2".

key.description: Optional representative phrase from the beat.

scenes.description: The script, in order. Cue codes interleave with dialogue exactly as they occur.

name.description: Scene or section heading, e.g. "第 3 场 · 正文情景（The Scene）".

k.description: B = beat heading, S = setting, A = action / blocking, T = delivery tip, L = dialogue line.

role.description: Required when k=L. One of roles, or the ensemble label.

text.description: For k=L this is the dialogue and must be byte-identical to the source script.

zh.description: Optional meaning-level gloss shown to the learner. A gist, not a literal translation.

key.description: Only meaningful on k=B: representative phrase for the beat card.
